description: This file defines the IProfileReader interface, which declares a method for asynchronously reading a user profile by username, with support for cancellation. It is used within the Profiles feature of the Conduit application.

classes.name: IProfileReader
classes.description: An interface that provides a method to read user profiles asynchronously, returning a ProfileEnvelope wrapped in a Task.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: An asynchronous method that retrieves user profile information based on username, supporting cancellation via CancellationToken.
